Hi. Welcome back. When we brought people off farms to work in factories at the beginning of the Industrial Revolution, society had to be reimagined. This is not different IMO. People have a way of rising to the occasion and finding a way to fit in. I don't think this Tech revolution will be any different. It is time for a change and that time is now. I see government becoming way smaller and cheaper with AI and robotics and I can't see that as being anything but good. I'm terrible at names, Is yours David? As far as UBI I see it only as a bridge. It will get us from a working world to an automated world. Once we are living in an automated world everything will become democratized and demonetized to the point where the prospect of working for another person on a regular job will almost appear as a form of insanity. At that point, the need for UBI will dissolve. Our bots will build, grow, produce, and provide everything we need to thrive.
